slots.ev: 白天在家的全身鏡前看膝蓋，冰敷袋就放在旁邊
slots.pil: 私下 / 收工後的鏡子前
slots.pl: 她家客廳角落的全身鏡前，白天，冰敷袋擱在地板上
slots.pl_en: on the floor in front of the full-length mirror in the corner of her living room in the daytime, an ice pack lying beside her
slots.ac: 她坐在地板上，一手按著膝蓋，另一手撐在身後
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the floor with one hand pressed to her knee and the other braced behind her.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：冰敷袋是隨身物品／幽默：最常吐槽自己的膝蓋
slots.of: 灰色運動內衣配同色低腰長褲
slots.of_en: a grey sports bra with matching low-rise leggings
slots.of_s: 私下核心：運動內衣 + 低腰褲／色盤：灰
slots.li: 大面窗的日光從側面進來，房間另一側暗
slots.li_en: Daylight from the big window comes in from the side, and the far side of the room is darker.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「練舞室的白日光燈…vs 家裡的暖光」——這一格是家裡的白天
slots.fa: 皺了一下眉，看著膝蓋那邊
slots.fa_en: A brief frown, her eyes on the knee.
slots.hair_en: in a high ponytail, the mint-green under-layer showing where it swings

slots.ev: 練完之後洗澡，那是她一天真正結束的點
slots.pl: 她家的浴室，剛練完澡，鏡子上有一層水氣
slots.pl_en: in her own bathroom straight after a shower following practice, a film of steam across the mirror
slots.ac: 她一手把濕頭髮往後撥，薄荷綠那一層這時候露出來
slots.ac_en: She is pushing her wet hair back with one hand, and the mint-green under-layer shows as she does it.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：薄荷綠那層頭髮只有甩起來才看得到
slots.of: 黑色運動內衣還沒換掉，下面是浴巾
slots.of_en: still in the black sports bra with a towel below it
slots.li: 鏡上那盞燈在她正前方，浴室深處被水氣吃掉
slots.li_en: The strip light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the far end of the bathroom is swallowed by the steam.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景改用單一暖光與淺景深」
slots.fa: 剛練完的紅，看著鏡頭，沒有笑
slots.fa_en: Still flushed from practice, looking at the lens without smiling.
slots.hair_en: wet and being pulled straight back, mint-green under-layer exposed

slots.ev: 學生都走了，她把大燈關掉自己再跑一次
slots.pl: 江南那間練舞室，收工後關了大燈，只剩鏡子旁的一盞，木地板
slots.pl_en: in the Gangnam dance studio after hours, the main lights off and only the one beside the mirror left on, wooden floor
slots.ac: 她停在一個動作的中間，重心壓在一腳上，兩手都甩開
slots.ac_en: She has stopped in the middle of a move, her weight down on one leg and both arms thrown out.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：練舞室關燈後的鏡子前
slots.of: 黑色露腰舞衣配低腰寬褲
slots.of_en: a black cropped dance top with low-slung wide trousers
slots.of_s: 標誌性配額：露腰舞衣 / 汗
slots.li: 鏡子旁那一盞燈在她側前方，練舞室深處全暗
slots.li_en: The single lamp beside the mirror is to one side and in front of her, and the far end of the studio is completely dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「高清晰度的舞蹈素材（動態需要）」
slots.fa: 喘著，眼睛看向鏡子那一側
slots.fa_en: Out of breath, her eyes towards the mirror side of the room.
slots.hair_en: high ponytail coming loose, strands stuck to her neck

slots.ev: 教完最後一堂走出來，便利商店外面的座位還有人
slots.pl: 江南一間便利商店外面的座位，深夜，剛教完課
slots.pl_en: at the outdoor seating of a Gangnam convenience store late at night, straight after teaching
slots.ac: 她坐在塑膠椅上，一手拿著飲料，另一手垂在腿上
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the plastic chair with a drink in one hand and the other hanging over her thigh.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：現在是那裡最多學生的老師之一
slots.of: 寬版連帽外套罩在舞衣外面，下面還是那條低腰褲
slots.of_en: an oversized hooded jacket thrown over the dance top, still in the same low-rise trousers
slots.li: 便利商店的白光從店裡打出來，座位區以外都暗
slots.li_en: White light spills out of the store across the seating, and everything beyond it is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍：這一格不用家裡的暖光，也不用練舞室的日光燈
slots.fa: 累到笑不出來，但看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Too tired to smile, but looking at the lens.
slots.hair_en: ponytail pulled out, hair down and flat

slots.ev: 白天在江南街上，她那身穿搭比舞蹈影片還多人看
slots.pl: 江南一條白天的街，商業大樓的玻璃在她身後
slots.pl_en: on a Gangnam street in the daytime, office glass behind her
slots.ac: 她站在路邊等人，重心壓在一腳，兩手都空著
slots.ac_en: She is standing at the kerb waiting for someone, her weight on one leg and both hands empty.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：帳號一開始只放 cover dance，後來她開始放自己
slots.of: 白色露腰短上衣配寬鬆低腰牛仔褲
slots.of_en: a white cropped top with loose low-rise jeans
slots.of_s: 色盤：冷白／標誌性配額以外的日常露腰
slots.li: 白天的天光是平的，大樓玻璃反回來一點
slots.li_en: The daylight is flat and the office glass throws a little of it back.
slots.li_s: 後製：這一格不是私下場景，所以不用單一暖光
slots.fa: 沒有表情，很直接地看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: No particular expression, looking very directly at the lens.
slots.hair_en: down and straight, mint-green under-layer just visible
